description: Validate an XML document with xmlvalid: well-formedness, an XSD, DTD or RelaxNG schema, and for e-invoices the Schematron business rules of EN 16931, Peppol BIS, XRechnung, Factur-X and national formats. Pass the document as `xml` (its text) or `url` (a public http(s) address), and a `schema`: a catalog slug from search_schemas, a saved schema ("@orders-v3"), or "auto" to use the e-invoice profile the document names. Without a schema only well-formedness is checked. Returns valid, errors and warnings with line, column, message, rule and a help_url explaining each. Counts as one API validation of the account's monthly quota.

name.description: A file name to show in the result, such as invoice-42.xml.

rules_version.description: Pin Schematron rule sets to releases, as rule-set@version, comma-separated (peppol-bis-3-ubl@3.0.21): the call fails with rules_version_mismatch when one has moved on. The result's rule_sets lists the releases that ran.

schema.description: A catalog slug (see search_schemas), "@<name>" for a saved schema, or "auto" for the e-invoice profile the document names. Leave out to check well-formedness only.

url.description: A public http(s) URL of the document, fetched by xmlvalid.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the result before returning a pending status to poll with get_validation; 30 when left out, 0 to return at once.

xml.description: The XML document itself. Use url instead for a document on the web.

name: validate_xml

error.description: What went wrong on our side when status is failed.

result.description: Null until the validation is done.

documents.description: For an archive: errors and warnings are then in items.

errors.description: The errors, the first 50 when errors_listed is set.

help_url.description: A page explaining this kind of error and how to fix it.

line.description: 0 when the message is about the whole document.

message_en.description: The message in English, for a rule its publisher wrote in another language.

path.description: Where a business rule fired, as an XPath with the document's prefixes.

rule.description: The business rule that failed, such as BR-CO-15; explain it with explain_rule.

type.description: syntax, xsd, relaxng, dtd, schema, io, schematron (a business rule), archive or pdf.

errors_listed.description: Set when errors were cut to this many; errors_total counts them all.

errors_truncated.description: More than the 500 errors the API keeps were found.

items.description: For an archive, one result per document.

pdf.description: For a PDF, the invoice found in it.

attachment.description: The XML file validated, such as factur-x.xml.

valid.description: True for the outcomes valid and warnings.

warnings.description: The warnings, the first 50 when warnings_listed is set.

help_url.description: A page explaining this kind of error and how to fix it.

line.description: 0 when the message is about the whole document.

message_en.description: The message in English, for a rule its publisher wrote in another language.

path.description: Where a business rule fired, as an XPath with the document's prefixes.

rule.description: The business rule that failed, such as BR-CO-15; explain it with explain_rule.

type.description: syntax, xsd, relaxng, dtd, schema, io, schematron (a business rule), archive or pdf.

warnings_listed.description: Set when warnings were cut to this many.

rule_sets.description: The Schematron rule sets that ran after the schema check, at their releases.

schema.description: Null when only well-formedness was checked.

detected.description: True when schema "auto" picked this profile.

status.description: queued or running: poll get_validation with the id; done: see result.

title: Validate XML
